g.text: The recordings clarify methods and expose open questions
Keep clarified mechanisms, separate talk editions and specific unanswered questions visible.

Bridgewater’s metric is precision@10 and its product direction is proactive participation. Range confirms an owner and separate reviewer. Kepler retains final post-processing. Vanguard’s seven-days-to-fifteen-minutes title concerns mainframe-code research, not investment research.

Ryan Stevens’s written Ramp evaluation account differs from Alexander Shevchenko’s keynote. Kepler’s attended breakout and next-day follow-up are different editions. Range’s online index label is October 13; attended notes remain Day 2. An index label is not a filming date.

Banking affiliation and “roundedness,” provider spelling, exact breakout retrieval defaults and several result denominators remain unresolved. Do not turn the confidence metaphor or incident coverage into a calibrated assurance or incidence estimate. Ask for the workload, population and comparison needed.
Sources: AIE NYC recordings, original notes, primary written follow-up and dated disclosures | Reviewed October 25, 2026
